repos.name: mizorewww/laya-mlx
repos.description: Native MLX runtime for Laya typed decision models — 7–14 ms short decisions on M3 Max. No text generation, PyTorch, or cloud API.
repos.one_liner: A high-performance, native MLX runtime for typed decision models optimized for Apple Silicon.
bullets: Built on Apple's MLX framework for hardware-accelerated inference on M3 Max chips.
Focuses on sub-15ms decision-making latency without the overhead of PyTorch or cloud APIs.
Designed for edge-based agentic decision loops rather than generative text tasks.
Ideal for low-latency quant trading signals or real-time local automation.

repos.name: Asymptote-Labs/agent-beacon
repos.description: Agent Beacon is the world's first open-source telemetry layer for AI agents wherever they run: locally, in CI, in the browser, or in the cloud.
repos.one_liner: An open-source, universal telemetry layer designed to monitor and trace AI agents across distributed environments.
bullets: Written in Go for high-performance, low-overhead observability.
Provides standardized logging and tracing for agents running in CI, browsers, or cloud infrastructure.
Enables developers to debug agentic reasoning chains and tool-use patterns in production.
Critical infrastructure for enterprise-grade AI agent deployment and compliance.

repos.name: qiz029/dscode
repos.description: A DeepSeek coding agent harness: persistent shell, Ultra subagents, auto approval, Chrome MCP and session telemetry
repos.one_liner: A comprehensive coding agent harness featuring persistent shell access and Chrome MCP integration.
bullets: Utilizes DeepSeek models with a persistent shell environment for autonomous software development.
Includes Ultra subagents and automated approval workflows to manage complex coding tasks.
Integrates Chrome MCP for web-based research and session telemetry for auditability.
Serves as a robust framework for building autonomous dev-agents that require browser interaction.

repos.name: lordx64/phantom-kv
repos.description: Refusal removal as a loadable KV-cache graft — zero weight modification, no refusal-direction projection, fully reversible.
repos.one_liner: A non-destructive method for removing model refusals via loadable KV-cache grafting.
bullets: Implements refusal removal without modifying model weights or requiring fine-tuning.
Uses a graft-based approach on the KV-cache, making the process fully reversible.
Avoids refusal-direction projection, preserving the model's original reasoning capabilities.
Highly relevant for researchers and developers needing to bypass restrictive safety filters in local LLMs.
repos.img2_alt: Pill hot-swap demo: base refuses, black pill answers, none restores

repos.name: zai-org/ZCode
repos.description: Z.ai's coding agent harness. Powerful, intelligent, extensible.
repos.one_liner: A powerful and extensible coding agent harness designed for intelligent software engineering workflows.
bullets: Built with TypeScript for high-performance integration within modern web-based dev environments.
Provides a structured harness for managing agentic coding tasks and multi-step logic.
Focuses on extensibility, allowing developers to plug in custom tools and specialized logic.
Targeted at professional developers looking to automate complex refactoring or feature implementation.
